documentedGaps.rationale: The DCR operation inventory has no independent protected resource that can distinguish token invalidation from the deleted ClientId becoming unknown. The requirement remains in the requirements catalogue as documented-only and is surfaced as not assessed.

intentionalChanges.legacyBehavior: POST registration is mandatory and locked in participant scope.
intentionalChanges.replacementDecision: Registration is a participant-selected conditional capability; management selections infer it only as required test setup.

intentionalChanges.legacyBehavior: RegisterClient, GetClient, UpdateClient, and DeleteClient are treated as source operation identifiers.
intentionalChanges.replacementDecision: Endpoints have no operationId because the authoritative OpenAPI defines none.

intentionalChanges.authority: Open Banking DCR 3.4 OpenAPI ClientRegistration request body
intentionalChanges.legacyBehavior: Registration and update send application/jose because that is how the legacy runner constructs requests.
intentionalChanges.replacementDecision: Test definitions declare the authoritative OpenAPI application/json media type and separately identify JWS request generation.

intentionalChanges.legacyBehavior: client_secret_post is rejected as a metadata value because the current runner cannot execute it.
intentionalChanges.replacementDecision: The requirements catalogue retains every source-defined token_endpoint_auth_method; runtime support policy remains outside normative requirements.

intentionalChanges.authority: Open Banking DCR 3.4 OBClientRegistrationRequest1 processing rules
intentionalChanges.replacementDecision: No fixed-status test is emitted because the specification permits rejection or substitution with a supported value.

classifications.rationale: Discovery advertises registration_endpoint as a SHOULD, so the replacement catalogue does not convert URL-shape validation into an ASPSP conformance requirement.
